title: FreshRSS
descript: FreshRSS is a self-hosted RSS and Atom feed aggregator. Subscribe to feeds, organize them into categories, search and filter articles, and read them in a clean web UI or through the API and mobile clients. This package runs the official Docker Hub image as a non-root container; the database, users and extensions live in the application data folder.
release_note: 1. First release: FreshRSS 1.30.4 from Docker Hub, x86_64 + aarch64, non-root.
important: Open the web UI and complete the first-run page to create the administrator account; there is no default password. Feed data and users live in DockerAppData/freshrssdocker/data, extensions in .../extensions. Automatic feed refresh is disabled in this non-root package; use the web UI refresh or an external scheduler. Needs DockerEngine; add a registry mirror if Docker Hub is unreachable. Back up data before uninstalling with data removal. Plain HTTP on the LAN.

zh-hk.descript: FreshRSS 是一個自託管的 RSS/Atom 訂閱聚合器。訂閱源、按分類整理、搜尋過濾文章，並透過清爽的網頁介面、API 或手機客戶端閱讀。本應用使用 Docker Hub 官方鏡像並以非 root 使用者運行；資料庫、使用者與擴充都保存在應用資料目錄。

zh-hk.release_note: 1. 首個版本：FreshRSS 1.30.4，來自 Docker Hub，x86_64 + aarch64 雙包，非 root。

data_notes: `data` holds `config.php`, the SQLite database (or DB settings), users and feed caches; `extensions` holds installed FreshRSS extensions. Copying `data` and `extensions` is a complete backup.
design_notes: **Non-root.** Runs as `1000:1000` with the mounted data/extensions folders writable.
**Two volumes, one port.** `/var/www/FreshRSS/data` + `/var/www/FreshRSS/extensions`; only port 80 is published.
**No root cron.** The images cron is disabled because the container is non-root; use the web UI refresh or an external scheduler.
**Fixed image tag**, Docker Hub only, no privileged mode, no host network, no Docker socket.
limitations: There is no default account. The first-run page is open until you create the administrator; complete it immediately after installation.
SQLite is used by default. Very large feed collections may benefit from an external database, which requires editing the configuration.
Plain HTTP on the LAN; do not expose the published port to the internet without a TLS reverse proxy.
